summary: Frontend E2E for new 'Medicamentos y Procedimientos (EXCLUSIVO IGSS)' section in /evaluacion-oftalmologica (superadmin, patient Juan Perez Lopez via ?paciente_id). ALL requested flows PASS: section exists with emerald accent (header gradient from-emerald-50, border #34d399, icon emerald-600), ordered exactly after 'Diagnóstico y Plan' and before 'Candidato a Cirugía'; add/edit/remove rows in both lists works correctly (removing middle row of 3 keeps correct remaining texts); badge counts total rows (4); Guardar -> POST 200 returns igss_med_proc with both lists; reload + Historial -> reopen shows same 2 medicamentos + 2 estudios; printer icon in section header opens .print-area (printType igss) with title 'MEDICAMENTOS Y PROCEDIMIENTOS (EXCLUSIVO IGSS)', subtitles 'Medicamentos' and 'Estudios / Procedimientos', numbered items; window.print invoked; 'Cerrar Vista Previa' closes it. Quick backend sanity: PUT persists, GET of legacy evaluation without field returns empty lists (200). No page errors.

minor.issue: Blank rows are persisted as empty strings (e.g. medicamentos ['TEST_X','']). Print view filters them, but DB keeps garbage entries; consider stripping empty items in frontend before save or in a Pydantic validator.

issues: Section is collapsed by default (defaultOpen={false}); the data-testid igss-med-proc-section only exists after expanding. Fine if intended, but on reopen of an evaluation with IGSS data the user doesn't see it until clicking (badge does show count).
Header toggle button and print icon span lack data-testid (e.g. igss-section-toggle, igss-print-btn) - tests had to use text/title selectors.
Printing with both lists empty renders only the title with no 'sin registros' text.
